sections.heading: Why shared fandoms matter when you are miles apart

blocks.text: A fandom gives long-distance couples rituals that travel well. You can watch the same series on separate couches, plan a themed video-call date, or send a sketch inspired by a world you both love. These small traditions make distance feel less like an absence and more like a story you are building together. That is why personalized long distance relationship gifts often feel more meaningful than expensive but impersonal items: they preserve the language that belongs specifically to your relationship.

blocks.text: Start with the feeling you want the finished portrait to have. You can explore [Demon Slayer](/portraits/demon-slayer), [Jujutsu Kaisen](/portraits/jujutsu-kaisen), [Dragon Ball Z](/portraits/dragon-ball-z), [Attack on Titan](/portraits/attack-on-titan), or [My Hero Academia](/portraits/my-hero-academia) for different visual directions. You do not need to know technical art terms; describe your shared fandom, preferred mood, clothing, colors, and memorable details in ordinary language.

Mention whether you want a cozy, funny, romantic, adventurous, or dramatic atmosphere.
